Name: Yandere Maru Mod
Author: marilamb16
Description:
[b][size=4]Mod Starts at 2 Hearts! Make Sure to be at 4 Hearts by Fall!
[/size]
UPDATE 2.0.0! New Events added to the mod! See below for event guide! 

UPDATE 1.5.0! Adds letters! 

UPDATE 1.2.5! Adds jealousy dialogue if you marry another person! Different lines for 2-5 hearts and 6+ hearts!

UPDATE 1.2.0! Adds Marriage Dialogue and edits some previous dialogue. Next update will add villager comments and Maru comments when you date and marry other bachelors!

[u]Requires Mail Framework Mod, Content Patcher & SMAPI[/u][/b]

I was tired of waiting for a Maru Yandere Mod to come out, so I made it myself! 

[b][u]Event Guide:[/u][/b]
[b]
3 Hearts:[/b] ﻿At your farm between 6 am to 10 am. Any day/weather.

[b]5 Hearts: [/b]Backwoods between mountains and your farm between 5 pm and 2 am. Any day/weather. Must have seen 3 hearts.
 
[b]7 Hearts: [/b]Maru's House between 10 am and 3 pm. Must have seen all prior custom events. Need 4 hearts with Robin.

[b]NEW 8 Hearts:[/b] Beach between 8 pm to 2 am. Must be raining. Must have seen all prior events.

[b]Jealousy Events:[/b]
﻿Shane: Forrest
Emily: Town
Sebastian: Mountains

[u]All jealousy events are any day/weather between 12 pm and 8 pm. Must be 9 hearts with anyone on the list.[/u]

Also if you have any suggestions on how I can improve my mod, feel free to let me know! I'm always willing to take constructive criticism! 

I hope you enjoy! <3
